title: FastAPI Server Routes, Wire Cache Header Collision & Deploy Guard Contract

findings.issue: App topology: server.py:384 declares FastAPI root app; / is a local handler (line 1658) caching in-memory at 45s default (line 627).

Wire cache header collision: server.py:610-611 middleware overwrites handler response with _CACHE_PATHS['/'] (line 516, default 60s). Browser/CDN sees public, max-age=60 while Python cache invalidates at 45s.
Deploy Guard bounds: tests/test_endpoint_contract.py:271-294 asserts non-404 and 200 status codes only; zero schema, payload, or cache-header assertions.
One-way contract coverage: test_registered_routes_cover_contract (lines 297-312) asserts contract is a subset of registered routes; uncontracted live endpoints are permitted.
